name: __NAME__
description: Turns an address with a numbered range, such as https://example.com/img[001-020].jpg, into a list of files to choose from.
author: __AUTHOR__

reasons.network: Downloads its program from the GitHub releases of __REPO__.
reasons.programs: Runs the program it downloaded to read the addresses you paste.

settings.label: Sites
settings.help: One address pattern per line. Addresses that match are expanded by this extension, for example https://example.com/gallery/*.

settings.label: Most files in a list
settings.help: A range with more files than this is cut short.
